judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, bug-free implementation that satisfies every acceptance criterion, including explicitly testing two full tool rounds (three provider calls) and recording the rationale for rejecting the breakdown shape in the spec and changelog. Both the candidate and reference chose to accumulate usage into a single hook parameter rather than passing a per-round breakdown. They differ slightly in surface and organization: the reference renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and accumulated inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, whereas the candidate introduced an exported `TurnUsageTotal` type alias, placed `totalReportedUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts`, and added a separate acceptance test file. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate also rewrote the entry in place under the 'Measured semantics' section rather than moving it up to the main requirements list like the reference did.
